rows.desktop_responsibility: Own Desktop standalone daemon entry identity, lifetime, signal-driven bounded shutdown, crash/invariant reporting and production-executor composition.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: The Desktop daemon cannot start without a generation-bound entry identity; it shuts down predictably, clears lifecycle state and reports fatal/invariant failures.
rows.ios_platform_delta: iOS does not spawn a standalone Node daemon. Coordinator actor lifetime replaces process lifetime, process identity remains a shared contract for remote/local-runner evidence, and execution uses the native/RemoteRunner split.
rows.production_evidence: Shipping MahayanaCoordinator owns IOSProductionLocalExecutor and IOSGenerationFencedRemoteRunnerTransport; Host platformExec requests reach Coordinator with account-revision + Host-generation fencing. However MahayanaCoordinator.make() currently does not inject a concrete IOSRemoteExecutionProviding and therefore uses IOSUnavailableRemoteExecutionProvider at the final remote dispatch edge. No second runtime is introduced; the standalone Node process remains platform-inapplicable.
rows.test_evidence: RunnerParityTests and native-engine focused tests cover exact remote namespaces, missing/stale account-generation fencing, cancellation/idempotency, and real Agent shell/process/box requests reaching PlatformExecBroker. Exact-head Actions plus a concrete shipping remote provider remain required before status promotion.
